en.title: Building resilient families: Balancing foresight and faith
en.description: Our faith teaches us that the sustenance of every person has been decreed by Allah s.w.t. It is Allah who grants children to whomever He wills. As responsible individuals, our duty is to prepare for the future as best as we can. Beyond that, we entrust our affairs to Allah, with full confidence in His wisdom and goodness.

ms.title: Membina keluarga berdaya tahan: Mengimbangi perancangan dan iman
ms.description: Akidah kita melandaskan bahawa rezeki setiap insan telah ditetapkan oleh Allah s.w.t. Allah yang mengurniakan zuriat kepada sesiapa yang Dia mahu. Sebagai insan yang bertanggungjawab, tugas kita adalah membuat persiapan untuk masa depan dengan sebaiknya. Selebihnya, kita serahkan urusan kita kepada Allah dengan penuh baik sangka.

ta.title: சகிப்புத்தன்மை மிக்க குடும்பங்களை உருவாக்குதல் : தொலைநோக்குப் பார்வையையும் நம்பிக்கையையும் சமநிலைப்படுத்துதல்
ta.description: Our faith teaches us that the sustenance of every person has been decreed by Allah s.w.t. It is Allah who grants children to whomever He wills. As responsible individuals, our duty is to prepare for the future as best as we can. Beyond that, we entrust our affairs to Allah, with full confidence in His wisdom and goodness.

en.title: Overcoming the whispers of the heart with faith
en.description: Nothing is hidden from Allah's knowledge, including the whispers that are never spoken aloud. We can only try to make sense of what we are going through, but Allah completely knows every unease and every complaint concealed within the heart.

ms.title: Menangani bisikan hati dengan keimanan
ms.description: Tiada sesuatu pun yang tersembunyi daripada pengetahuan Allah, termasuklah juga bisikan yang tidak terungkap. Kita hanya mampu mencuba untuk memahami apa yang sedang kita alami, tetapi Allah mengetahui sepenuhnya segala keresahan dan keluhan yang tersirat di dalam hati.

ta.title: ஓரிறை நம்பிக்கையால் இதயத்தின் முணுமுணுப்பை வெல்வது
ta.description: Nothing is hidden from Allah's knowledge, including the whispers that are never spoken aloud. We can only try to make sense of what we are going through, but Allah completely knows every unease and every complaint concealed within the heart.

en.title: Prophetic guidance: Endurance, hope, renewal
en.description: The pure teachings of the Prophet s.a.w, the values he upheld throughout his life, did not end with his passing. They crossed the boundaries of place and time to reach us, here, today, by the will of Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Hadyun Nabawi: Ketabahan, harapan, pembaharuan
ms.description: Ajaran Rasulullah s.a.w. yang murni; nilai-nilai yang Baginda s.a.w. tegakkan sepanjang kehidupannya, tidak terhenti selepas pemergiannya. Ia merentasi batasan tempat dan masa untuk sampai kepada diri kita sendiri, hari ini, dengan izin Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: இறைத்தூதுவத்துவ வழிகாட்டுதல் : சகிப்புத்தன்மை, ஆதரவு வைத்தல், புதுப்பித்தல்
ta.description: The pure teachings of the Prophet s.a.w, the values he upheld throughout his life, did not end with his passing. They crossed the boundaries of place and time to reach us, here, today, by the will of Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Prophetic guidance: Cultivating critical minds, nurturing wisdom
en.description: The Prophet s.a.w. introduced an educational revolution that shaped both the human mind and character. In today's age of abundance in information and Artificial Intelligence (AI), our challenge is no longer simply gaining access to information. Rather, it is developing critical minds that can distinguish truth from falsehood and evaluate matters with fairness and discernment.

ms.title: Hadyun Nabawi: Menyemai minda kritis, memupuk hikmah
ms.description: Rasulullah s.a.w. membawa revolusi pendidikan yang membina pemikiran dan jati diri. Dalam era limpahan maklumat dan Kecerdasan Buatan (Artificial Intelligence) hari ini, cabaran kita bukan sekadar mendapatkan maklumat, tetapi membina minda yang kritis, yang berdaya menapis kebenaran daripada kepalsuan, serta menilai setiap perkara secara saksama.

ta.title: இறைத்தூதுவத்துவ வழிகாட்டுதல் : விமர்சன சிந்தனையை ஏற்படுத்தி. ஞானத்தை வளர்த்தல்
ta.description: The Prophet s.a.w. introduced an educational revolution that shaped both the human mind and character. In today's age of abundance in information and Artificial Intelligence (AI), our challenge is no longer simply gaining access to information. Rather, it is developing critical minds that can distinguish truth from falsehood and evaluate matters with fairness and discernment.

en.title: Becoming an individual whom Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. is proud of
en.description: Making the Prophet s.a.w. proud does not require extraordinary achievements. It can begin with the simplest things that he s.a.w. taught.

ms.title: Menjadi insan kebanggaan Nabi Muhammad s.a.w.
ms.description: Membanggakan Nabi s.a.w. tidak memerlukan pencapaian yang luar biasa. Ia boleh bermula dengan perkara-perkara yang paling ringkas yang diajarkan Baginda s.a.w.

ta.title: இறைத்தூதர் முஹம்மது[ஸல்] அவர்கள் பெருமை கொள்ளும் நபராக ஆகுதல்
ta.description: Making the Prophet s.a.w. proud does not require extraordinary achievements. It can begin with the simplest things that he s.a.w. taught.

en.title: Prophetic guidance: Living life with exemplary character
en.description: Hadyun Nabawi is the approach exemplified by the Prophet s.a.w, equips us with resilience, strength, and confidence to face the challenges of our time without compromising our religious principles.

ms.title: Hadyun Nabawi: Mengharungi kehidupan dengan akhlak mulia
ms.description: Hadyun Nabawi, yakni pendekatan yang ditunjukkan oleh Nabi, membekalkan kita daya tahan (resilience), kecekalan jiwa, dan keyakinan untuk berdepan dengan cabaran setiap zaman tanpa menggadaikan pegangan agama.

ta.title: இறைத்தூதுவத்துவ வழிகாட்டுதல்: முன்மாதிரியான குணநலன்களுடன் வாழ்வது
ta.description: Hadyun Nabawi is the approach exemplified by the Prophet, equips us with resilience, strength, and confidence to face the challenges of our time without compromising our religious principles.

en.title: Love for Prophet Muhammad s.a.w.
en.description: We show our love for the Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. in different ways. Some work hard to practice his daily teachings – sunnah. Some love to recite qasidah or burdah in praise for him. Others try to reflect his teachings in how they speak and act. Whatever way we choose to show our love for him, let us keep doing it, so long as it stays within the boundaries of Islamic law.

ms.title: Kecintaan kepada Nabi Muhammad s.a.w.
ms.description: Kita menzahirkan cinta kepada Nabi Muhammad s.a.w. dengan cara yang berbeza. Ada yang gigih mengamalkan sunnah-sunnah harian. Ada yang suka mengalunkan qasidah memuji Baginda s.a.w. Ada juga yang menggayakan ajarannya menerusi tutur kata mahupun perbuatan. Kesimpulannya, apa pun cara kita menzahirkan cinta kepada Nabi Muhammad s.a.w, teruskanlah selagi ia masih berada dalam batasan syarak.

ta.title: இறைத்தூதர் முஹம்மது[ஸல்] அவர்களை நேசிப்பது
ta.description: We show our love for the Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. in different ways. Some work hard to practice his daily teachings – sunnah. Some love to recite qasidah or burdah in praise for him. Others try to reflect his teachings in how they speak and act. Whatever way we choose to show our love for him, let us keep doing it, so long as it stays within the boundaries of Islamic law.

en.title: Ihsan: Manifesting gratitude through excellence
en.description: The teachings of ihsan in these narrations are meant to cultivate a constant sense of awareness of Allah. When we carry this awareness in our hearts, we naturally strive to perfect everything we do and constantly reach for excellence.

ms.title: Ihsan: Menzahirkan kesyukuran melalui kecemerlangan
ms.description: Nilai ihsan ini seharusnya menimbulkan kesedaran bahawa diri kita sentiasa diawasi oleh Allah. Dan apabila perasaan ini terpahat dalam hati, kita akan sentiasa berusaha memperbaiki setiap pekerjaan yang kita lakukan, sekaligus berusaha mencapai kecemerlangan.

ta.title: ஓரிறை நம்பிக்கையாளர் விட்டுச் செல்லும் பரம்பரைச் சொத்து
ta.description: The teachings of ihsan in these narrations are meant to cultivate a constant sense of awareness of Allah. When we carry this awareness in our hearts, we naturally strive to perfect everything we do and constantly reach for excellence.

en.title: The legacy of a believer
en.description: The Quran encourages us to plan our lives, whether for our education, our career, or our retirement. The same applies to death. Whether we like it or not, this preparation must be made. Because what we prepare and what we will leave behind should bring benefit.

ms.title: Legasi peninggalan seorang mukmin
ms.description: Al-Quran menganjurkan kita membuat perancangan hidup, baik untuk pendidikan, mahupun untuk kerjaya, dan persaraan.  Begitulah juga halnya dengan kematian. Suka atau tidak, persiapan ini perlu dilakukan. Kerana apa yang kita persiapkan dan bakal tinggalkan seharusnya membawa manfaat.

ta.title: ஓரிறை நம்பிக்கையாளர் விட்டுச் செல்லும் பரம்பரைச் சொத்து
ta.description: The Quran encourages us to plan our lives, whether for our education, our career, or our retirement. The same applies to death. Whether we like it or not, this preparation must be made. Because what we prepare and what we will leave behind should bring benefit.

en.title: Preserving the integrity of our religious lives
en.description: Islam places immense weight on preserving the integrity of religious life. This refers to an attitude of caution and wisdom in dealing with religious knowledge. Through religious knowledge, we come to understand Allah's commands, prohibitions, and guidance, which in turn shapes the identity of our religious life.

ms.title: Memelihara keutuhan kehidupan beragama
ms.description: Islam amat menitikberatkan keutuhan kehidupan beragama. Ini merujuk kepada sikap berhati-hati dan bijaksana dalam menilai ilmu agama. Menerusi ilmu agama, kita memahami perintah, larangan dan petunjuk Allah, hingga akhirnya membentuk jati diri kehidupan beragama.

ta.title: நமது மார்க்க வாழ்க்கையின் ஒருமைப்பாட்டைப் பாதுகாப்பது
ta.description: Islam places immense weight on preserving the integrity of religious life. This refers to an attitude of caution and wisdom in dealing with religious knowledge. Through religious knowledge, we come to understand Allah's commands, prohibitions, and guidance, which in turn shapes the identity of our religious life.

en.title: Diversity – Together in pursuit of excellence
en.description: Allah places the diversity of humankind alongside the creation of the heavens and the earth as one of His magnificent signs. This teaches us that differences in race, language and culture are not something to be viewed with suspicion or used as reasons for conflict and division. Rather, they are part of Allah's divine order, inviting us to recognise the greatness of our Creator.

ms.title: Kepelbagaian: Bersama menuju kecemerlangan
ms.description: Allah s.w.t. meletakkan kepelbagaian manusia seiring dengan penciptaan langit dan bumi sebagai tanda kebesaran-Nya. Ini menunjukkan bahawa perbezaan bangsa, bahasa dan budaya bukanlah sesuatu yang perlu dipandang dengan rasa curiga atau dijadikan sebab untuk bertelagah lalu berpecah. Sebaliknya, ia adalah sunnatullah yang mengajak kita mengenali kebesaran Sang Pencipta.

ta.title: பன்முகத்தன்மையும், சிறப்பை நோக்கியப் பயணத்தில் ஒன்றிணைந்து செயல்படுதலும்
ta.description: Allah places the diversity of humankind alongside the creation of the heavens and the earth as one of His magnificent signs. This teaches us that differences in race, language and culture are not something to be viewed with suspicion or used as reasons for conflict and division. Rather, they are part of Allah's divine order, inviting us to recognise the greatness of our Creator.

en.title: Health: The oft-neglected trust and blessing
en.description: We are entrusted with the duty of guarding our health and the well-being of our bodies. This is an amanah, and it is also a blessing. Unfortunately, it is also a blessing that is often neglected by many people, and only mourned once it is lost.

ms.title: Kesihatan: Amanah & nikmat yang sering terabai
ms.description: Kita diamanahkan untuk menjaga kesihatan diri dan tubuh badan kita. Inilah amanah, inilah juga nikmat. Malangnya, inilah juga nikmat yang sering diabaikan ramai manusia dan hanya mula ditangisi setelah kehilangannya.

ta.title: உடல் நலம்: அடிக்கடி புறக்கணிக்கப்படும் அமானிதமும் அருளும்
ta.description: We are entrusted with the duty of guarding our health and the well-being of our bodies. This is an amanah, and it is also a blessing. Unfortunately, it is also a blessing that is often neglected by many people, and only mourned once it is lost.

en.title: Righteous youth – A shared responsibility
en.description: The way young people perceive life is shaped by the environment created by the adults around them. It is therefore a sacred trust upon the shoulders of every adult, especially among the believers, to play a role in guiding the youth in accordance with divine guidance.

ms.title: Belia bertakwa, amanah bersama
ms.description: Gambaran belia terhadap kehidupan dipengaruhi persekitaran yang dibentuk oleh golongan dewasa. Maka, menjadi amanah di atas pundak setiap orang dewasa, terutama sekali dari kalangan kaum mukmin, memainkan peranan membimbing golongan belia mengikut panduan Ilahi.

ta.title: நேர்மையான இளைஞரை உருவாக்குவது –  பகிர்ந்து கொள்ள வேண்டிய ஒரு பொறுப்பு
ta.description: The way young people perceive life is shaped by the environment created by the adults around them. It is therefore a sacred trust upon the shoulders of every adult, especially among the believers, to play a role in guiding the youth in accordance with divine guidance.

en.title: Asyura through the lens of tadabbur
en.description: Human beings are prone to forgetting Allah, as well as His blessings and various forms of help, once hardship and trials have passed. People then begin to be deceived by their own greatness, assuming that everything they possess is the result of their own efforts, when in truth every blessing comes from Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Asyura menerusi lensa tadabbur
ms.description: Manusia mudah melupakan Tuhan, serta nikmat dan segala macam bantuan Allah setelah berlalunya kesusahan dan ujian. Lalu manusia mula tertipu dengan kehebatan dirinya, dan menyangka segala yang dimilikinya adalah hasil usahanya, sedangkan setiap nikmat datang daripada Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: ஆஷூரா : ததப்புரின் கண்ணாடியில்
ta.description: Human beings are prone to forgetting Allah, as well as His blessings and various forms of help, once hardship and trials have passed. People then begin to be deceived by their own greatness, assuming that everything they possess is the result of their own efforts, when in truth every blessing comes from Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Tadabbur: A lifelong companion
en.description: Today’s khutbah will illustrate how a single verse of the Quran conveys different messages to its readers, depending on their experiences, circumstances, and stage of life.

ms.title: Tadabbur: Teman sepanjang hayat
ms.description: Khutbah akan memperlihatkan bagaimana sepotong ayat Al-Quran yang sama menyampaikan mesej yang berbeza kepada pembaca, mengikut pengalaman, keadaan, serta fasa kehidupan mereka.

ta.title: ததப்புர் : ஒரு வாழ்நாள் தோழன்
ta.description: Today’s khutbah will illustrate how a single verse of the Quran conveys different messages to its readers, depending on their experiences, circumstances, and stage of life.

en.title: Delayed gratification – A Quranic concept
en.description: This world and the Hereafter are not two separate paths. We are not commanded to choose between one or the other. Rather, every effort we make in this world can become a path which connects this world to our Hereafter, if done with the intention of seeking the pleasure of Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Ganjaran yang ditangguhkan – Satu gagasan al-Quran
ms.description: Dunia dan akhirat bukanlah dua jalan yang terpisah. Kita tidak diminta untuk memilih antara dunia atau akhirat. Bahkan, setiap usaha kita semuanya boleh menjadi jalan yang menghubungkan dunia dan akhirat sekiranya dilakukan dengan niat mengharapkan keredaan Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: தாமதமாகக் கிடைக்கும் வெகுமதிகளை அடைதல் – குர்ஆனியச் சிந்தனை
ta.description: This world and the Hereafter are not two separate paths. We are not commanded to choose between one or the other. Rather, every effort we make in this world can become a path which connects this world to our Hereafter, if done with the intention of seeking the pleasure of Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Tadabbur – One verse, endless guidance
en.description: Tadabbur is the act of arriving at understanding through observation and reflection.

ms.title: Tadabbur – Sebaris ayat, sejuta bimbingan
ms.description: Tadabbur adalah memahami sesuatu melalui penelitian dan pemerhatian.

ta.title: ததப்புர்: ஒரு வசனம், எண்ணற்ற வழிகாட்டுதல்கள்
ta.description: Tadabbur is the act of arriving at understanding through observation and reflection.

en.title: Sacrificing self-centredness, strengthening unity
en.description: Beyond the slaughtering of animals, there lies a deeper spirit of sacrifice – the willingness to let go of our sense of self-centredness, and to prioritise the well-being of others.

ms.title: Korbankan keakuan, kukuhkan kekitaan
ms.description: Di sebalik penyembelihan haiwan korban, tersirat roh pengorbanan yang lebih besar – iaitu kesediaan untuk mengorbankan sifat mementingkan diri sendiri serta mendahulukan kebaikan orang lain. Inilah mesej utama khutbah pada hari ini.

ta.title: சுயநலத்தைத் தியாகம் செய்து, ஒற்றுமையைப் பலப்படுத்துதல்
ta.description: Beyond the slaughtering of animals, there lies a deeper spirit of sacrifice – the willingness to let go of our sense of self-centredness, and to prioritise the well-being of others.

en.title: Aidiladha sermon: Exploring the wisdom behind acts of worship
en.description: Aidiladha teaches us a broader meaning of sacrifice. It is not merely the slaughtering of the sacrificial animal, but also the readiness to submit to the guidance of Allah s.w.t, even when it requires us to adapt to circumstances, without sacrificing our principles.

ms.title: Khutbah Aidiladha: Menelusuri hikmah dalam pelaksanaan ibadah
ms.description: Aidiladha mengajar kita makna pengorbanan yang lebih luas. Ia bukan sekadar menyembelih haiwan korban, tetapi juga kesediaan untuk tunduk kepada petunjuk Allah s.w.t, meskipun ia memerlukan kita menyesuaikan diri dengan keadaan, tanpa mengorbankan prinsip.

ta.title: வெள்ளிக்கிழமைப் பிரசங்கம்: வணக்க, வழிபாட்டுச் செயல்களின் பின்னணியில் உள்ள தத்துவத்தை அறிதல்
ta.description: Aidiladha teaches us a broader meaning of sacrifice. It is not merely the slaughtering of the sacrificial animal, but also the readiness to submit to the guidance of Allah s.w.t, even when it requires us to adapt to circumstances, without sacrificing our principles.

en.title: Istita’ah in worship
en.description: Istita’ah is the capability and capacity to carry out Islam’s obligations in the best manner possible.

ms.title: Istita’ah dalam ibadah
ms.description: Istita’ah ialah kemampuan dan keupayaan untuk melaksanakan tuntutan Islam dengan sebaik mungkin.

ta.title: வணக்கத்தை நிறைவேற்ற இஸ்திதாஅத் [சக்தி] பெற்றிருப்பது
ta.description: Istita’ah is the capability and capacity to carry out Islam’s obligations in the best manner possible.

en.title: A sound mind, a meaningful life
en.description: The well-being of a person’s life is closely tied to the well-being of the mind. When the intellect is properly nurtured and protected, life becomes more guided, and meaningful.

ms.title: Akal sejahtera, kehidupan bermakna
ms.description: Kesejahteraan hidup seseorang berkait rapat dengan kesejahteraan akalnya. Apabila akal dipelihara dengan baik, maka kehidupan juga akan menjadi lebih terpandu dan bermakna.

ta.title: சிறந்த அறிவாற்றலும் பொருள்மிக்க வாழ்க்கையும்
ta.description: The well-being of a person’s life is closely tied to the well-being of the mind. When the intellect is properly nurtured and protected, life becomes more guided, and meaningful.

en.title: Muslim families and today’s challenges
en.description: Reminding one another for the sake of Allah is a sign of deep love. Sincere advice is not meant to judge, rather, it is a sign of concern for a person’s relationship with Allah.

ms.title: Keluarga Muslim dan cabaran masa kini
ms.description: Saling mengingatkan kerana Allah adalah tanda kasih sayang yang mendalam. Nasihat yang ikhlas bukan untuk menghukum, tetapi tanda keprihatinan terhadap hubungan seseorang dengan Allah.

ta.title: இஸ்லாமியக் குடும்பங்களும் தற்காலச் சவால்களும்
ta.description: Reminding one another for the sake of Allah is a sign of deep love. Sincere advice is not meant to judge, rather, it is a sign of concern for a person’s relationship with Allah.

en.title: Youth and today’s challenges
en.description: The challenges faced by youth today reflect even greater challenges that may affect the whole of society tomorrow.

ms.title: Belia dan cabaran masa kini
ms.description: Cabaran belia hari ini sebenarnya mencerminkan cabaran lebih besar yang boleh melanda segenap lapisan masyarakat esok.

ta.title: இளைஞர்களும் இன்றைய சவால்களும்
ta.description: The challenges faced by youth today reflect even greater challenges that may affect the whole of society tomorrow.

en.title: Islam and culture
en.description: Culture refers to practices and norms that are passed down from generation to generation – whether in speech or in action – and are associated with a particular community or people. At times, there is an overlap between cultural practices and religious observance.

ms.title: Islam dan budaya
ms.description: Budaya adalah suatu kebiasaan yang diwarisi turun-temurun, sama ada dalam bentuk pertuturan atau perbuatan, yang disandarkan pada suatu kaum atau bangsa. Terkadang, berlaku percampuran antara budaya dengan pengamalan agama.

ta.title: இஸ்லாமும் கலாச்சாரமும்
ta.description: Culture refers to practices and norms that are passed down from generation to generation – whether in speech or in action – and are associated with a particular community or people. At times, there is an overlap between cultural practices and religious observance.

en.title: Lessons from the Islamic tradition of knowledge
en.description: The Islamic tradition of knowledge produced some of the greatest minds the world has seen such as al-Khawarizmi, Ibn Sina, and al-Biruni, and many others whose contributions in fields like mathematics, medicine, and astronomy continue to benefit humanity today.

ms.title: Pengajaran daripada tradisi ilmu Islam
ms.description: Tradisi ilmu Islam telah melahirkan tokoh-tokoh agung seperti al-Khawarizmi, Ibn Sina, dan Al-Biruni, serta ramai lagi yang telah menyumbang dalam bidang matematik, perubatan, dan astronomi yang manfaatnya masih dirasai hingga ke hari ini.

ta.title: இஸ்லாத்தின் பாரம்பரியக் கல்வியறிவிலிருந்து பெற வேண்டிய பாடங்கள்
ta.description: The Islamic tradition of knowledge produced some of the greatest minds the world has seen such as al-Khawarizmi, Ibn Sina, and al-Biruni, and many others whose contributions in fields like mathematics, medicine, and astronomy continue to benefit humanity today.

en.title: Ithar – The pinnacle of generosity
en.description: Ithar is a noble quality of selflessness, placing the needs of others above one’s own interests. It represents the highest form of generosity; giving even when one is in need.

ms.title: Ithar – Kemuncak sifat berjiwa besar
ms.description: Ithar ialah sifat berjiwa besar, mendahulukan keperluan orang lain melebihi kepentingan diri sendiri. Ia merupakan kemuncak kemurahan hati, memberi walaupun diri sendiri dalam keadaan memerlukan.

ta.title: ஈஸார் –  தாராள மனப்பான்மையின் உச்சகட்ட நிலை
ta.description: Ithar is a noble quality of selflessness, placing the needs of others above one’s own interests. It represents the highest form of generosity; giving even when one is in need.

en.title: The etiquette of joy in Islam
en.description: Happiness and joy are part of our natural disposition, and Sunnah – especially for a believer when receiving the blessings of Allah.

ms.title: Adab bergembira dalam Islam
ms.description: Bergembira adalah fitrah dan satu sunnah, terutama sekali bagi seorang mukmin apabila dia menerima anugerah Allah.

ta.title: இஸ்லாத்தில் மகிழ்ச்சியடைவதற்கான ஒழுங்கு முறை
ta.description: Happiness and joy are part of our natural disposition, and Sunnah – especially for a believer when receiving the blessings of Allah.

en.title: The trials of maintaining ties
en.description: Relationships between people are not always easy or pleasant. At times they are calm and harmonious, but at other times they are tested with tension and misunderstandings.

ms.title: Ujian menjaga hubungan silaturahmi
ms.description: Hubungan sesama manusia tidak sentiasa mudah dan menyenangkan. Adakalanya tenang dan tenteram, terkadang pula diuji dengan ketegangan dan perselisihan faham.

ta.title: உறவுமுறைகளைப் பாதுகாப்பதில் ஏற்படும் சோதனைகள்
ta.description: Relationships between people are not always easy or pleasant. At times they are calm and harmonious, but at other times they are tested with tension and misunderstandings.

en.title: Aidilfitri sermon: Worldly life: A test for mankind
en.description: Our success in completing the acts of worship during the month of Ramadan did not depend solely on our own efforts. Rather, it is by the mercy and love of Allah s.w.t. upon all His servants.

ms.title: Khutbah Aidilfitri: Kehidupan dunia: Medan ujian untuk manusia
ms.description: Kejayaan kita menyempurnakan ibadah pada bulan Ramadan bukan hanya bergantung kepada usaha diri kita sendiri sahaja. Sebaliknya, ia adalah atas rahmat dan kasih sayang Allah s.w.t. terhadap sekalian hamba-hambanya.

ta.title: நோன்புப் பெருநாள் பிரசங்கம்: உலக வாழ்க்கை : மனிதகுலத்துக்கு ஒரு சோதனை
ta.description: Our success in completing the acts of worship during the month of Ramadan did not depend solely on our own efforts. Rather, it is by the mercy and love of Allah s.w.t. upon all His servants.

en.title: Reflection and hope at the end of Ramadan
en.description: Among the goals that every believer should strive for in this blessed month is to attain the forgiveness of Allah s.w.t. Rasulullah s.a.w. said: “Ruined is he who encounters the month of Ramadan, yet it passes while he has not been forgiven.” (At-Tirmizi)

ms.title: Muhasabah dan harapan di akhir Ramadan
ms.description: Antara perkara yang seharusnya menjadi matlamat seorang Mukmin pada bulan ini adalah untuk mendapatkan pengampunan Allah s.w.t.  Rasulullah s.a.w. bersabda yang bermaksud: ”Rugilah seseorang yang bertemu bulan Ramadan, kemudian Ramadan berlalu sedangkan dia belum diampunkan.” (Riwayat At-Tirmizi)

ta.title: ரமதானின் இறுதியில் சிந்திப்பதும் ஆதரவு வைப்பதும்
ta.description: Among the goals that every believer should strive for in this blessed month is to attain the forgiveness of Allah s.w.t. Rasulullah s.a.w. said: “Ruined is he who encounters the month of Ramadan, yet it passes while he has not been forgiven.” (At-Tirmizi)

en.title: Laylatul Qadr – Seeking a better decree
en.description: According to scholars of tafsir such as Imam Ibn Kathir, this means that on Laylatul Qadr, all matters such as provision, trials, and events for the coming year are distinguished and apportioned by Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Lailatulqadar – Memohon takdir yang lebih baik
ms.description: Menurut ahli tafsir seperti Imam Ibn Kathir, ia bererti bahawa malam Lailatulqadar adalah masanya setiap rezeki, ujian dan setiap peristiwa bagi tahun yang akan datang ditentukan dan ditetapkan oleh Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: லைலதுல் கத்ர் : ஒரு சிறந்த விதியை நாடுதல்
ta.description: According to scholars of tafsir such as Imam Ibn Kathir, this means that on Laylatul Qadr, all matters such as provision, trials, and events for the coming year are distinguished and apportioned by Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Al-Quran: A source of tranquillity in troubled times
en.description: Today, as we find ourselves surrounded by fitnah – trials and confusion – in a world that remains in turmoil and causes us fear and anxiety, the Quran continues to stand by our side, providing guidance and direction.

ms.title: Al-Quran sumber ketenangan di kala keresahan
ms.description: Dalam suasana hari ini, di mana kita terus dikelilingi fitnah dan kebingungan. Dunia terus bergolak, menimbulkan ketakutan dan keresahan, Al-Quran terus setia membawa pedoman dan bimbingan.

ta.title: திருக்குர்ஆன்: பிரச்சனைக்குரிய காலங்களில் அமைத்திக்கான ஆதாரமாக உள்ளது
ta.description: Today, as we find ourselves surrounded by fitnah – trials and confusion – in a world that remains in turmoil and causes us fear and anxiety, the Quran continues to stand by our side, providing guidance and direction.

en.title: Cultivating the essence of Ubudiyyah at home in Ramadan
en.description: Our homes are not merely places of rest, shelter, and worldly affairs. Rather, in Islam, the home is the first madrasah and the first environment where individuals and families are nurtured in Ubudiyyah – devotion and servitude to Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Menyuburkan Ubudiyyah di rumah pada bulan Ramadan
ms.description: Rumah kita bukan sekadar tempat berehat, berlindung dan menjalani urusan dunia. Bahkan rumah adalah madrasah dan persekitaran yang pertama, di mana individu dan keluarga menerima latihan ‘Ubudiyyah, atau pengabdian kepada Tuhannya.

ta.title: ரமதானில், நமது வீடுகளையும் உபூதிய்யத்தின் சாராம்சத்தால் பிரகாசிக்கச் செய்வது
ta.description: Our homes are not merely places of rest, shelter, and worldly affairs. Rather, in Islam, the home is the first madrasah and the first environment where individuals and families are nurtured in Ubudiyyah – devotion and servitude to Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Ramadan: Towards a believer’s transformation
en.description: Fasting requires patience. The Prophet s.a.w. said in a hadith narrated by Imam At-Tirmizi, which means: “Fasting is half of patience.”

ms.title: Ramadan: Ke arah transformasi mukmin
ms.description: Ibadah puasa memerlukan kesabaran. Rasulullah s.a.w. juga bersabda dalam sepotong hadith riwayat Imam At-Tirmizi yang bermaksud: “Ibadah puasa adalah separuh kesabaran.”

ta.title: ரமதான் : ஓரிறை நம்பிக்கையாளரிடம் ஏற்பட வேண்டிய மாற்றம்
ta.description: Fasting requires patience. The Prophet s.a.w. said in a hadith narrated by Imam At-Tirmizi, which means: “Fasting is half of patience.”

en.title: Arrival of Ramadan – The importance of preparation
en.description: Ramadan is not merely a month of worship. It is a spiritual and moral training for the rest of lives. Our goal is to nurture lasting transformation, not temporary motivation.

ms.title: Ketibaan Ramadan – Kepentingan membuat persediaan
ms.description: Ramadan bukanlah sekadar ibadah sebulan, tetapi latihan rohani dan jati diri untuk sepanjang kehidupan. Matlamat kita ialah memupuk perubahan yang kekal, bukan semangat yang bersifat sementara.

ta.title: ரமதானின் வருமையும் தயாரிப்பு செய்து கொள்வதன் அவசியமும்
ta.description: Ramadan is not merely a month of worship. It is a spiritual and moral training for the rest of lives. Our goal is to nurture lasting transformation, not temporary motivation.

en.title: Sincerity – The hidden good deeds
en.description: Surah Al-Bayyinah, verse 5 reminds us that religious life requires sincerity. Without sincerity, it becomes harder for us to remain steadfast on the path of goodness.

ms.title: Ikhlas – Kebaikan yang tersembunyi
ms.description: Kehidupan beragama memerlukan keikhlasan. Tanpa sifat ikhlas, lebih sukar untuk kita terus teguh atas jalan kebaikan.

ta.title: நேர்மை : ஒரு மறைமுகமான நற்காரியமாகும்
ta.description: Surah Al-Bayyinah, verse 5 reminds us that religious life requires sincerity. Without sincerity, it becomes harder for us to remain steadfast on the path of goodness.

en.title: Prayer – The key to success and inner peace
en.description: In today’s society, time is indeed a valuable resource. However, for a Muslim, our prayer should never be seen as an obstacle to success. On the contrary, prayer strengthens the soul and becomes a driving force for individual excellence and success in every aspect of life.

ms.title: Solat – Kunci kejayaan dan ketenangan
ms.description: Dalam konteks masyarakat hari ini, masa yang kita miliki merupakan satu sumber yang bernilai. Namun, bagi seorang Muslim, solat tidak sepatutnya menjadi penghambat kecemerlangan. Sebaliknya, solat adalah penguat jiwa dan pemacu kecemerlangan peribadi serta seluruh kehidupan.

ta.title: தொழுகை: வெற்றியும் மன அமைதியும் கிடைப்பதற்கான வணக்கமாகும்
ta.description: In today’s society, time is indeed a valuable resource. However, for a Muslim, our prayer should never be seen as an obstacle to success. On the contrary, prayer strengthens the soul and becomes a driving force for individual excellence and success in every aspect of life.

en.title: Faith, brotherhood, and collective strength
en.description: The Prophet s.a.w. understood the profound impact of brotherhood or togetherness in servitude, for when it is rooted in faith, is it entails reminding, motivating, supporting, and advising one another wisely in pursuit of Allah’s pleasure.

ms.title: Iman, persaudaraan dan kekuatan bersama
ms.description: Rasulullah s.a.w. memahami kesan persaudaraan dalam pengabdian, kerana persaudaraan berteraskan keimanan akan saling mengingatkan, mendorong, menyokong dan menegur dengan hikmah dalam usaha meraih keredaan Allah.

ta.title: ஓரிறை நம்பிக்கை, சகோதரத்துவம், கூட்டு வலிமை
ta.description: The Prophet s.a.w. understood the profound impact of brotherhood or togetherness in servitude, for when it is rooted in faith, is it entails reminding, motivating, supporting, and advising one another wisely in pursuit of Allah’s pleasure.

en.title: Isra’ and Mi’raj – Reflections on the nature of time
en.description: Isra' and Mi'raj is a night that carried countless meanings and endless guidance for the entire ummah. Among the profound lessons of Isra’ and Mi‘raj is the value of time.

ms.title: Israk dan Mikraj – Iktibar tentang masa
ms.description: Antara iktibar yang kita perolehi daripada peristiwa Israk dan Mikraj adalah tentang kepentingan nilai masa. Satu malam yang melahirkan seribu pengertian dan pedoman, menjadi titipan buat kita hingga ke akhir masa.

ta.title: இஸ்றா, மிஃராஜ் : காலம் மற்றும் நேரத்தின்
ta.description: Isra’ and Mi‘raj is a night that carried countless meanings and endless guidance for the entire ummah. Among the profound lessons of Isra’ and Mi‘raj is the value of time.

en.title: The importance of learning the sirah
en.description: The Messenger of Allah s.a.w. – our teacher and our guide. Through his guidance, he purifies hearts, illuminates souls with the teachings of the Qur’an, and shows us the path of faith and wisdom.

ms.title: Keutamaan mempelajari sirah Nabi s.a.w.
ms.description: Rasulullah s.a.w. – pendidik dan pembimbing kita. Baginda menyucikan hati manusia melalui bimbingannya, menerangi jiwa dengan ajaran Al-Quran dan menunjukkan kepada kita jalan iman dan kebijaksanaan.

ta.title: ”சீராஹ்” எனும் வரலாற்றை அறிந்து கொள்வதன் அவசியம்
ta.description: The Messenger of Allah s.a.w. – our teacher and our guide. Through his guidance, he purifies hearts, illuminates souls with the teachings of the Qur’an, and shows us the path of faith and wisdom.

en.title: Beginning our step with steadfastness
en.description: The best provision in life is not wealth, rank, or worldly success, but a steadfast stance tied to Allah in every circumstance.

ms.title: Memulakan langkah dengan istiqamah
ms.description: Sebaik-baik bekalan dalam hidup ini bukanlah harta, pangkat atau kejayaan duniawi, tetapi pendirian yang istiqamah terikat dengan Allah dalam setiap keadaan.

ta.title: உறுதிப்பாட்டுடன் நமது அடிகளை எடுத்து வைத்து ஆரம்பித்தல்
ta.description: Best provision in life is not wealth, rank, or worldly success, but a steadfast stance tied to Allah in every circumstance.

en.title: Traversing life with the end in mind
en.description: Death is certain, and it can come when we least expect it. It does not care whether we are young or old, healthy or sick, rich or poor. Death does not wait for us to be in a state of complete iman or piety before it takes us. Therefore, we must live each day with awareness of the end and in preparation for it, by constantly striving to worship Allah s.w.t. and to do good deeds.

ms.title: Meniti kehidupan, mengingati pengakhiran
ms.description: Kematian adalah suatu kepastian, dan ia mungkin datang pada saat yang paling tidak dijangkakan. Hendaklah kita meniti setiap hari-hari kita dengan kesedaran akan pengakhiran hidup kita, sentiasa berusaha untuk beribadah kepada Allah s.w.t. dan memperbanyakkan amal soleh.

ta.title: மரணத்தை நினைவில் கொண்டு, வாழ்வது
ta.description: Death is certain, and it can come when we least expect it. It does not care whether we are young or old, healthy or sick, rich or poor. Death does not wait for us to be in a state of complete iman or piety before it takes us. Therefore, we must live each day with awareness of the end and in preparation for it, by constantly striving to worship Allah s.w.t. and to do good deeds.

en.title: Purpose and priorities in life
en.description: A mindful Muslim is one who is clear about the purpose of their life. They do not allow pressure, busyness, or day-to-day routines to dictate the direction of their life. Instead, by identifying their priorities and purpose in every effort, they align their entire life so that it consistently moves towards the pleasure of Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Tujuan dan keutamaan dalam kehidupan
ms.description: Seorang Muslim yang peka adalah insan yang jelas dengan tujuan kehidupannya. Dia mengenal pasti keutamaan serta tujuan dalam setiap pekerjaan, dia menyelaraskan keseluruhan hidupnya agar sentiasa bergerak ke arah keredaan Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: வாழ்க்கையின் நோக்கமும் முன்னுரிமை கொடுக்க வேண்டிய விஷயங்களும்
ta.description: A mindful Muslim is one who is clear about the purpose of their life. They do not allow pressure, busyness, or day-to-day routines to dictate the direction of their life. Instead, by identifying their priorities and purpose in every effort, they align their entire life so that it consistently moves towards the pleasure of Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Connections that nurture tranquillity
en.description: In Islam, stepping back and regulating our busyness is not only permissible, but at times necessary and beneficial.

ms.title: Jalinan yang menjana ketenangan
ms.description: Menurut prinsip Islam, tidak menjadi sesuatu kesalahan, malah kadangkala menjadi keperluan dan besar manfaatnya, untuk kita mengurangkan dan mengatur kesibukan.

ta.title: அமைதியை வளர்க்கும் தொடர்புகள்
ta.description: In Islam, stepping back and regulating our busyness is not only permissible, but at times necessary and beneficial.

en.title: Cultivating the practice of self-reflection
en.description: Every action we take carries weight in the sight of Allah. Muhasabah helps us fulfil our responsibilities at work, act with proper etiquette in society, and be patient in the face of challenges.

ms.title: Membudayakan amalan bermuhasabah
ms.description: Muhasabah membantu kita menjaga amanah di tempat kerja, beradab dalam bermasyarakat dan bersabar dalam menghadapi tekanan.

ta.title: சுய பரிசோதனை செய்து கொள்வதைச் செயல்படுத்துதல்
ta.description: Every action we take carries weight in the sight of Allah. Muhasabah helps us fulfil our responsibilities at work, act with proper etiquette in society, and be patient in the face of challenges.

en.title: Navigating the loss of loved ones
en.description: Navigating grief and addressing it is essential. If left unaddressed, grief can become overwhelming, affecting our life, thoughts, and actions, leading us astray in ways that distance us from the path of righteousness and Allah’s pleasure.

ms.title: Menghadapi pemergian orang yang dikasihi
ms.description: Mengurus emosi apabila berlaku kematian adalah amat penting. Jika tidak diurus dengan baik, kedukaan boleh menjadi satu beban yang membelenggu kehidupan, pemikiran serta tindakan, sehingga menjauhkan seorang Muslim daripada jalan kebenaran dan keredaan Allah.

ta.title: பிரியத்திற்குரியவர்களை இழக்கும் போது ஏற்படும் கவலைகளைச் சமாளிப்பது
ta.description: Navigating grief and addressing it is essential. If left unaddressed, grief can become overwhelming, affecting our life, thoughts, and actions, leading us astray in ways that distance us from the path of righteousness and Allah’s pleasure.

en.title: Living a meaningful life
en.description: Every passing day brings us closer to the end of this worldly life. Use the gift of age with full awareness and responsibility. Beautify our deeds and prepare ourselves for the life to come.

ms.title: Kehidupan bermakna di sepanjang usia
ms.description: Setiap hari yang berlalu membawa kita semua lebih hampir kepada garis penamat kehidupan. Indahkan amalan dan persiapkan diri untuk kehidupan yang seterusnya.

ta.title: பொருள்மிக்க வாழ்க்கையாக வாழ்வது
ta.description: Every passing day brings us closer to the end of this worldly life. Use the gift of age with full awareness and responsibility. Beautify our deeds and prepare ourselves for the life to come.

en.title: Attaining paradise through our parents
en.description: As our parents age, we must adjust our lives to care for them according to their changing needs and conditions. We must prepare ourselves to ensure that they receive the best care possible.

ms.title: Mengecap syurga melalui ibu bapa
ms.description: Apabila ibu bapa kita meniti usia senja, kita perlu menyesuaikan diri dan bersedia untuk menjaga mereka dengan penuh keihsanan, mengikut kesesuaian dan keperluan mereka yang berubah-ubah.

ta.title: நமது பெற்றோர்கள் மூலம் சொர்க்கத்தை அடைதல்
ta.description: As our parents age, we must adjust our lives to care for them according to their changing needs and conditions. We must prepare ourselves to ensure that they receive the best care possible.

en.title: Instilling tranquillity in family relationships
en.description: The bond between us and our families must always remain a priority. Protect our families from negative influences, including those that may arise from within ourselves. Resolve daily to keep striving towards goodness together with our loved ones.

ms.title: Menyuntik ketenangan dalam hubungan kekeluargaan
ms.description: Hubungan erat dan pergaulan baik antara kita dan keluarga mestilah diutamakan. Lindungilah keluarga kita daripada persekitaran yang negatif, termasuklah yang terbit daripada diri kita sendiri.

ta.title: குடும்ப உறவில் அமைதியை ஏற்படுத்துவது
ta.description: The bond between us and our families must always remain a priority. Protect our families from negative influences, including those that may arise from within ourselves. Resolve daily to keep striving towards goodness together with our loved ones.

en.title: The humility of a Muslim
en.description: True humility does not mean showing weakness or lowering one’s dignity. It also does not mean humbling oneself for worldly gain from mankind.

ms.title: Kerendahan hati seorang Muslim
ms.description: Tawaduk yang sebenar tidak bermakna kita menzahirkan kelemahan dan merendahkan maruah dengan sengaja. Bukan pula dengan menundukkan diri untuk mendapatkan manfaat daripada manusia.

ta.title: முஸ்லிமிடம் காணப்பட வேண்டிய பனிவு மனப்பான்மை
ta.description: True humility does not mean showing weakness or lowering one’s dignity. It also does not mean humbling oneself for worldly gain from mankind.

en.title: Islam and digital engagement
en.description: There is a clear warning from Allah about the temporary nature of worldly life. It is filled with entertainment that can either amuse or distract us if not managed properly.

ms.title: Islam dan interaksi digital
ms.description: Peringatan jelas dari Allah tentang kehidupan dunia yang bersifat sementara. Ia penuh dengan permainan yang menghibur dan melalaikan, jika tidak diurus dengan baik.

ta.title: இஸ்லாமும் டிஜிடல் ஈடுபாடும்
ta.description: There is a clear warning from Allah about the temporary nature of worldly life. It is filled with entertainment that can either amuse or distract us if not managed properly.

en.title: The weight of righteous friendship
en.description: Good friends are those who emphasise taqwa and righteousness, who enjoy doing good, and who consistently encourage us to follow the same path.

ms.title: Nilai persahabatan yang baik
ms.description: Sahabat yang baik adalah sahabat yang mementingkan ketakwaan dan kebaikan; yang suka berbuat baik dan sering mendorong kita ke arah yang sama.

ta.title: நேர்மையான தோழமையின் மதிப்பு
ta.description: Good friends are those who emphasise taqwa and righteousness, who enjoy doing good, and who consistently encourage us to follow the same path.

en.title: Filial piety: A divine command
en.description: Allah s.w.t. commands us to lower the wing of humility out of mercy. Hence, mercy is fundamental in our act of humility toward our parents.

ms.title: Berbakti kepada ibu bapa: Satu tuntutan Ilahi
ms.description: Antara perintah agung yang Allah s.w.t. berikan kita, selepas perintah agar kita menyembah-Nya, ialah perintah untuk berbuat baik dan berbakti kepada kedua ibu bapa.

ta.title: பெற்றோருக்குச் செய்ய வேண்டிய உபகாரம்: அல்லாஹ்வின் கட்டளையாகும்
ta.description: Among the greatest commands that Allah s.w.t. has given us after commanding us to worship Him alone, is the command to honour and do good to our parents.

en.title: Children: A gift, a trust, and a test
en.description: Children are indeed blessings, and at the same time, a test upon both parents. Through children, one is tested as to how steadfast he remains in obeying Allah.

ms.title: Anak: Anugerah, amanah dan ujian
ms.description: Zuriat adalah satu nikmat yang datang bersamanya ujian bagi kedua ibu bapanya. Menerusi anak-anak, seseorang itu diuji sejauh mana dia dapat beristiqamah mentaati Allah.

ta.title: பிள்ளைகள்: வெகுமதிகள், அமானிதங்கள், சோதனைகள்
ta.description: Children are indeed blessings, and at the same time, a test upon both parents. Through children, one is tested as to how steadfast he remains in obeying Allah.

en.title: Resilience amid hardship
en.description: At times, a trial serves as kaffarah – a form of expiation of sins from Allah s.w.t. However, this does not mean that every trial we face is a punishment, nor should it be seen as a form of humiliation.

ms.title: Ketabahan di sebalik kepayahan
ms.description: Adakalanya ujian adalah kafarah atau balasan daripada Allah s.w.t. Tetapi ini tidak bermakna setiap ujian yang menimpa merupakan satu hukuman, atau mungkin dilihat sebagai satu penghinaan ke atas diri kita.

ta.title: கஷ்டமான காலத்திலும் சகிப்புத்தன்மையுடன் காணப்படுவது
ta.description: At times, a trial serves as kaffarah – a form of expiation of sins from Allah s.w.t. However, this does not mean that every trial we face is a punishment, nor should it be seen as a form of humiliation.

en.title: Conduits of sunnah, dwellers of Jannah
en.description: If we truly love Allah, we must first follow and emulate Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. In return, Allah s.w.t. will grant us His mercy and forgive our mistakes.

ms.title: Menyubur sunnah, menuju Jannah
ms.description: Jika kita mencintai Allah, maka kita mestilah terlebih dahulu mengikuti dan mencontohi Rasulullah s.a.w. Sebagai ganjaran, Allah akan melimpahkan kasih sayang-Nya serta pengampunan-Nya ke atas kesilapan kita.

ta.title: சுன்னாஹ் எனும் வழிமுறையும் சொர்க்கவாசிகளும்
ta.description: If we truly love Allah, we must first follow and emulate Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. In return, Allah s.w.t. will grant us His mercy and forgive our mistakes.

en.title: Wasatiyyah: The golden trait of our ummah
en.description: Differences reflect the diversity of scholarly opinions within our religion. Even the companions of the Prophet s.a.w. themselves differed in certain matters. Yet, they did not allow those differences to hinder unity, harmony, or love among them.

ms.title: Wasatiyyah: Ciri utama umat Islam
ms.description: Sahabat Nabi s.a.w. juga berbeza pendapat dalam beberapa perkara. Namun, mereka tidak membiarkan perbezaan itu menjadi penghalang kepada perpaduan, keharmonian dan kasih sayang sesama mereka.

ta.title: வஸதிய்யாஹ்: நமது சமுதாயத்தின் சிறந்த பண்பாகும்
ta.description: Differences reflect the diversity of scholarly opinions within our religion. Even the companions of the Prophet s.a.w. themselves differed in certain matters. Yet, they did not allow those differences to hinder unity, harmony, or love among them.

en.title: The teacher of souls: Prophetic nurturing
en.description: Rasulullah s.a.w. didn’t just convey knowledge. He inspired, guided, and profoundly touched the hearts of everyone he met.

ms.title: Pendidik hati: Didikan nabawi
ms.description: Rasulullah s.a.w. tidak sekadar menyampaikan ilmu. Baginda memberi inspirasi, membimbing, dan menyentuh hati setiap orang yang bertemu dengannya, sekaligus meninggalkan kesan yang mendalam.

ta.title: ஆன்மாக்களின் ஆசிரியர்: இறைத்தூதுதரின் வளர்ப்பு
ta.description: Rasulullah s.a.w. didn’t just convey knowledge. He inspired, guided, and profoundly touched the hearts of everyone he met.

en.title: Truthfulness: The key to Paradise
en.description: Truly, the quality of truthfulness shapes the entire life of a believer. This trait provides a positive influence into how a person speaks, behaves — whether in public or in private — and interacts with the creation of Allah.

ms.title: Berlaku benar sebagai kunci syurga
ms.description: Sesungguhnya sifat berlaku benar membentuk kehidupan seorang Mukmin secara keseluruhannya. Sifat ini menyuntik pengaruh positif pada cara seseorang berbicara dan berkelakuan.

ta.title: உண்மை, சொர்க்கம் செல்வதற்கான திறவுகோல் ஆகும்
ta.description: Truly, the quality of truthfulness shapes the entire life of a believer. This trait provides a positive influence into how a person speaks, behaves — whether in public or in private — and interacts with the creation of Allah.

en.title: Leadership begins from within
en.description: Self-leadership is the foundation of all leadership. If we cannot guide ourselves to be responsible and obedient servants of Allah s.w.t., we cannot expect to lead others to do the same.

ms.title: Kepimpinan bermula daripada diri sendiri
ms.description: Kepimpinan diri adalah asas segala bentuk kepimpinan. Jika kita tidak mampu membimbing diri sendiri untuk menjadi hamba Allah s.w.t. yang amanah, kemungkinan besar kita juga tidak mampu membimbing orang lain ke arah yang sama.

ta.title: தலைமைத்துவம் நம்மிடமிருந்து ஆரம்பமாக வேண்டும்
ta.description: Self-leadership is the foundation of all leadership. If we cannot guide ourselves to be responsible and obedient servants of Allah s.w.t., we cannot expect to lead others to do the same.

en.title: Attaining divine assistance through serving others
en.description: A Muslim should not focus solely on ritual acts of worship, while neglecting opportunities to serve and help others. Rather, they believe that by extending help to others, they also draw nearer to Allah’s mercy and assistance.

ms.title: Berkhidmat kepada insan, peroleh bantuan Tuhan
ms.description: Seorang Muslim tidak hanya menumpukan perhatian kepada ibadah ritual. Sebaliknya, dia yakin bahawa dengan menghulurkan bantuan kepada manusia, dia juga mendekatkan diri kepada kurniaan rahmat dan pertolongan Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: மற்றவர்களுக்கு சேவை செய்வதன் மூலம் அல்லாஹ்வின் உதவியை அடைதல்
ta.description: A Muslim should not focus solely on ritual acts of worship, while neglecting opportunities to serve and help others. Rather, they believe that by extending help to others, they also draw nearer to Allah’s mercy and assistance.

en.title: A good land and a forgiving Lord
en.description: Gratitude means truly appreciating Allah’s gifts. This requires continued effort and hard work from everyone to preserve the blessings granted by Allah s.w.t.

ms.title: Tanah air yang baik, Tuhan yang pengampun
ms.description: Bersyukur bermakna kita menghargai setiap kurniaan Allah. Usaha dan kerja keras yang berterusan, daripada setiap lapisan masyarakat, adalah perlu untuk memelihara nikmat yang Allah berikan.

ta.title: வளமான நிலமும் மன்னிக்கும் இறைவனும்
ta.description: Gratitude means truly appreciating Allah’s gifts. This requires continued effort and hard work from everyone to preserve the blessings granted by Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Faithful guidance in facing distress
en.description: The story of Maryam a.s. teaches us that stress and emotional burden are part and parcel of life. Every person will face it, and it is not a sign of weak faith.

ms.title: Panduan iman dalam menghadapi tekanan
ms.description: Kisah Maryam a.s. menunjukkan kepada kita bahawa tekanan dan keresahan adalah lumrah dalam kehidupan insan. Setiap manusia akan mengalaminya, dan ia bukanlah tanda kelemahan iman.

ta.title: மன உளைச்சலை எதிர்கொள்வதற்கு நம்பத்தகுந்த வழிகாட்டுதல்
ta.description: The story of Maryam a.s. teaches us that stress and emotional burden are part and parcel of life. Every person will face it, and it is not a sign of weak faith.

en.title: Becoming an exemplary individual
en.description: As Muslims, we perceive Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. to be the finest role model. He consistently radiated noble character in every circumstance, serving as a role model for all of us.

ms.title: Melangkah menjadi insan contoh
ms.description: Sebagai Muslim, kita menjadikan Nabi Muhammad s.a.w. suri teladan. Rasulullah s.a.w. memancarkan akhlak yang luhur dalam setiap keadaan dan ketika, sekaligus menjadi teladan bagi kita semua.

ta.title: முன்மாதிரியான தனிநபராக ஆகுதல்
ta.description: As Muslims, we perceive Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. to be the finest role model. He consistently radiated noble character in every circumstance, serving as a role model for all of us.

en.title: Hijrah – A gateway to communal unity
en.description: Islam calls for a society that cultivates love amid diversity. In this world, we are entrusted to be bearers of mercy and callers to justice - not only among fellow Muslims, but to all of humanity, without exception.

ms.title: Hijrah - Pintu perpaduan ummah
ms.description: Islam menyeru kepada masyarakat yang menyemai kasih di tengah kepelbagaian. Di dunia ini, kita diamanahkan menjadi pembawa rahmat dan penyeru keadilan. Bukan sekadar sesama Islam, tetapi untuk seluruh umat manusia, tanpa batasan.

ta.title: ஹிஜ்ரத் : சமுதாய ஒற்றுமைக்கான வழி
ta.description: Islam calls for a society that cultivates love amid diversity. In this world, we are entrusted to be bearers of mercy and callers to justice - not only among fellow Muslims, but to all of humanity, without exception.

en.title: Ahluz zikr: A shared vision
en.description: We must be knowledgeable believers, upholding and honouring knowledge for the benefit of present and future generations, while preparing a strong generation of successors.

ms.title: Ahluz zikr: Satu visi bersama
ms.description: Kita mesti menjadi mukmin yang berilmu, dan memartabatkan ilmu untuk manfaat generasi hari ini dan akan datang, dan menyiapkan generasi pelapis.

ta.title: அஹ்லுத் திக்ர்: பகிர்ந்து கொள்ளப்பட வேண்டிய நோக்கம்
ta.description: We must be knowledgeable believers, upholding and honouring knowledge for the benefit of present and future generations, while preparing a strong generation of successors.

en.title: Asyura – Upholding truth, overcoming oppression
en.description: A hadith narrated by Imam Muslim, the Prophet s.a.w. said which means: "I hope from Allah that it (fasting on the Day of Asyura) will expiate the sins of the previous year."

ms.title: Asyura – Menegakkan kebenaran, mengatasi kezaliman
ms.description: Dalam hadith riwayat Muslim, Rasulullah s.a.w. bersabda yang bermaksud: “Aku berharap kepada Allah agar ia (berpuasa pada Hari Asyura) menghapuskan dosa setahun yang lalu.”

ta.title: ஆஷூரா: உண்மையைப் பற்றிப் பிடிப்பதும் அடக்குமுறையை வெற்றிகொள்வதும்
ta.description: A hadith narrated by Imam Muslim, the Prophet s.a.w. said which means: "I hope from Allah that it (fasting on the Day of Asyura) will expiate the sins of the previous year."

en.title: Awal Muharram – Towards spiritual renewal
en.description: The month of Muharram marks the first chapter of the Islamic calendar. This is the only month in the Islamic calendar that the Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. referred to as “شَهْرُ الله” – the “Month of Allah.”

ms.title: Awal Muharram – Ke arah pembaharuan rohani
ms.description: Bulan Muharram membuka lembaran pertama dalam takwim Islam. Bulan ini adalah satu-satunya bulan dalam kalendar Islam yang disebut oleh Rasulullah s.a.w. sebagai "شَهْرُ الله" – yakni “Bulan Allah”.

ta.title: முஹர்ரம் முதல் நாள்: ஆன்மீக ஆற்றலைப் புதுப்பித்துக் கொள்வது
ta.description: The month of Muharram marks the first chapter of the Islamic calendar. This is the only month in the Islamic calendar that the Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. referred to as “شَهْرُ الله” – the “Month of Allah.”

en.title: Balancing principledness and compassion
en.description: Steadfastness in upholding Islamic principles and compassion for others – are not in conflict. In fact, they can and should coexist within ourselves, as demonstrated in the noble character of the Prophet Muhammad s.a.w.

ms.title: Mengimbangi keteguhan prinsip dan perasaan belas
ms.description: Kedua-dua sifat ini – keteguhan menjunjung prinsip Islam dan perasaan belas  sesama insan – tidak seharusnya dilihat bercanggah antara satu sama lain. Malah, kedua-duanya boleh wujud bersama, dan dapat kita lihat pada peribadi Rasulullah s.a.w.

ta.title: கொள்கை ரீதியிலான தன்மைக்கும் கருணைச் சிந்தனைக்கும் மத்தியில் சமநிலையைக் கடைப்பிடிப்பது
ta.description: Steadfastness in upholding Islamic principles and compassion for others – are not in conflict. In fact, they can and should coexist within ourselves, as demonstrated in the noble character of the Prophet Muhammad s.a.w.

en.title: Our duty as khalifah on earth
en.description: The weight of our responsibility as khalifah is real, and we must be the ambassadors for change and betterment, and not destruction.

ms.title: Tanggungjawab sebagai khalifah di muka bumi
ms.description: Tanggungjawab kita sebagai khalifah di muka bumi ini adalah amanah yang besar. Kita seharusnya menjadi pemangkin perubahan dan pembaikan, bukan penyumbang ke arah kerosakan.

ta.title: இப்பூமியில் கலீஃபா எனும் ரீதியில் நமது கடமை
ta.description: The weight of our responsibility as khalifah is real, and we must be the ambassadors for change and betterment, and not destruction.

en.title: Aidiladha khutbah: Faith and conviction as the foundation of sacrifice
en.description: Aidiladha holds many lessons and wisdoms. Among the events we must reflect upon and draw lessons from is the great test of faith faced by Prophet Ibrahim a.s. when he was commanded by Allah to sacrifice his beloved son Prophet Ismail a.s.

ms.title: Khutbah Aidiladha: Keimanan dan keyakinan teras pengorbanan
ms.description: Antara pengajaran Aidiladha yang perlu kita hayati dan mengambil iktibar, adalah ujian agung keimanan yang dilalui Nabi Ibrahim a.s, apabila baginda diperintahkan Allah untuk mengorbankan anaknya yang tersayang.

ta.title: ஓரிறை நம்பிக்கையும் திட நம்பிக்கையும் தியாகத்தின் அடிப்படையான விஷயங்கள்
ta.description: Aidiladha holds many lessons and wisdoms. Among the events we must reflect upon and draw lessons from is the great test of faith faced by Prophet Ibrahim a.s. when he was commanded by Allah to sacrifice his beloved son Prophet Ismail a.s.

en.title: Reflections on the Day of Arafah
en.description: Arafah is a plain outside the city of Makkah, where Muslims performing Haj gather. This gathering is considered the pinnacle of Haj – so essential that the Haj is not valid without it.

ms.title: Muhasabah Hari Arafah
ms.description: Arafah adalah sebidang dataran di luar kota Makkah, tempat di mana umat Islam yang melaksanakan haji berkumpul. Inilah perhimpunan yang dianggap sebagai kemuncak ibadah Haji – malah begitu penting sehingga Haji seseorang tidak sah tanpanya.

ta.title: அரஃபா தினத்தைப் பற்றி சிந்தனை செய்தல்
ta.description: Arafah is a plain outside the city of Makkah, where Muslims performing Haj gather. This gathering is considered the pinnacle of Haj – so essential that the Haj is not valid without it.

en.title: Understanding istita’ah, enlivening Zulhijjah
en.description: It is profound how Allah mentions istita‘ah - the capability to perform acts of worship, particularly in hajj. Here lies one of the beauties of the Islamic jurisprudence: it never burdens, but rather facilitates and eases a person’s obedience.

ms.title: Memahami istita'ah, menghidupkan Zulhijjah
ms.description: Allah menyebutkan tentang istita’ah, yakni keupayaan dalam menyempurnakan ibadah, khususnya ibadah haji. Di sini terletak salah satu keindahan syariat Islam. Ia tidak pernah membebankan, malah memudahkan insan menjalankan ketaatan.

ta.title: ”இஸ்திதாஆ” என்பதை அறிதல், துல்ஹஜ் மாதத்தை உயிர்ப்பித்தல்
ta.description: It is profound how Allah mentions istita‘ah - the capability to perform acts of worship, particularly in hajj. Here lies one of the beauties of the Islamic jurisprudence: it never burdens, but rather facilitates and eases a person’s obedience.

en.title: My body, my amanah
en.description: Amanah is best understood as a responsibility to uphold trust with morality, integrity, and honesty. In Islam, it signifies being answerable for duties or trusts entrusted to us.

ms.title: Tubuhku, amanahku
ms.description: Amanah membawa makna ‘kepercayaan’. Kepercayaan bahawa setiap nikmat dan keistimewaan yang kita miliki adalah pinjaman daripada Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: என்னுடைய உடல், எனது அமானிதம்
ta.description: Amanah is best understood as a responsibility to uphold trust with morality, integrity, and honesty. In Islam, it signifies being answerable for duties or trusts entrusted to us.

en.title: Preserving marital bonds
en.description: The sermon seeks to focus on the importance of resilience and closeness in the relationship between husband and wife, as they complement one another.

ms.title: Memelihara keeratan rumahtangga
ms.description: Khutbah minggu ini ingin memberikan tumpuan pada pentingnya keutuhan dan keeratan hubungan suami isteri, kerana mereka saling melengkapkan, sesuai dengan panduan Al-Qur’an dalam Surah Al-Baqarah, ayat 187.

ta.title: திருமண உறவைப் பாதுகாப்பது
ta.description: The sermon seeks to focus on the importance of resilience and closeness in the relationship between husband and wife, as they complement one another.

en.title: The marriage institution in Islam
en.description: Every marriage in Islam should have three important characteristics: sakinah, mawaddah, and rahmah.

ms.title: Institusi perkahwinan dalam Islam
ms.description: Setiap rumahtangga Islam perlu memiliki tiga ciri penting: sakinah, mawaddah, dan rahmah.

ta.title: இஸ்லாத்தில் திருமண அமைப்பு
ta.description: Every marriage in Islam should have three important characteristics: sakinah, mawaddah, and rahmah.

en.title: Belief in recompense: Living with awareness of the hereafter
en.description: The Day of Recompense and Judgement is a day when all judgement and accountability for human actions belong solely to Allah s.w.t. To Him belongs all power and absolute sovereignty which never diminishes.

ms.title: Keimanan kepada pembalasan; Menjalani hidup dengan kesedaran Akhirat
ms.description: Apapun pengalaman mahupun perjalanan kehidupan di dunia, kita meyakini akan hari pembalasan dan perhitungan, berdasarkan akidah agama Islam. Hari di mana segala penghukuman dan pengadilan bagi perbuatan manusia hanya milik Allah s.w.t.

ta.title: கூலிகள் வழங்கப்படுவதில் நம்பிக்கைக் கொள்வது: மறுமை நாளைப் பற்றிய விழிப்புணர்வுடன் வாழ்வது
ta.description: The Day of Recompense and Judgement is a day when all judgement and accountability for human actions belong solely to Allah s.w.t.

en.title: Guidance through the approach of Targhib (persuasion) and Tarhib (dissuasion)
en.description: Allah’s forgiveness and His punishment are truly a testament to the perfection of His asma’ - names, and His attributes.

ms.title: Bimbingan menerusi pendekatan Targhib (galakan) dan Tarhib (amaran)
ms.description: Ayat-ayat Quran yang menyebutkan keampunan dan azab Allah s.w.t. ini sebenarnya membuktikan kesempurnaan asma’ (nama-nama Allah) dan sifat-Nya.

ta.title: தர்கீப் [ஆர்வமூட்டுதல்], தர்ஹீப் [எச்சரிக்கை செய்தல்] ஆகியவற்றின் மூலம் வழிகாட்டுதல்
ta.description: Allah’s forgiveness and His punishment are truly a testament to the perfection of His asma’ - names, and His attributes.

en.title: Generosity: The catalyst of barakah
en.description: Generosity is a product of compassion, and a trait which is essential for us to manifest.

ms.title: Sikap pemurah pemangkin keberkatan
ms.description: Kemurahan hati lahir daripada rasa ihsan, dan merupakan satu sifat yang penting untuk kita zahirkan.

ta.title: விசாலமானக் கொடைத் தன்மை; பரக்கத்தை அதிகரிப்பதாகும்
ta.description: Generosity is a product of compassion, and a trait which is essential for us to manifest.

en.title: Balancing cultural identity and religious integrity
en.description: Our cultural heritage adds beautiful dimensions to our identity, and by thoughtfully aligning these traditions with Islamic principles, we strengthen both our family bonds and our faith.

ms.title: Mengimbangi identiti kebudayaan dan keutuhan agama
ms.description: Warisan budaya memperkaya identiti kita. Dengan mengimbangi tradisi ini secara sedar dan menyelaraskannya dengan prinsip Islam, kita memperkukuh hubungan kekeluargaan serta keimanan kita.

ta.title: கலாச்சாரத் தனித்துவத்துக்கும் மார்க்க ஒருமைப்பாட்டுக்கும் மத்தியில் சமநிலையைக் கடைப்பிடிப்பது
ta.description: Our cultural heritage adds beautiful dimensions to our identity, and by thoughtfully aligning these traditions with Islamic principles, we strengthen both our family bonds and our faith.

en.title: The duty of maintaining silaturrahim
en.description: Silaturrahim transcends tradition and customs. It is a religious obligation that reflects a Muslim’s faith, to the extent that it is tied to the command of taqwa.

ms.title: Kewajipan menjaga silaturahim
